Class GameSettings

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.system.GameSettings
public class GameSettings extends Object
Singleton class that manages global game settings and configuration. Stores per-piece settings (color, spawn rate, visibility) for both standard and custom Tetrominoes. Also manages general game configuration defaults. This class acts as the central repository for all customizable game data.

    • saveCustomPiece

      public void saveCustomPiece(String name, boolean[][] design)
      Saves a design grid for a custom piece interactively created by the user. Creates a deep copy of the design array to ensure data integrity.
      Parameters:
      name - the unique name of the custom piece
      design - the 2D boolean array representing the piece's shape

    • clearCustomPiece

      public void clearCustomPiece(String name)
      Resets the design of a custom piece to an empty grid. The piece entry remains in the system.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the custom piece to clear

    • removeCustomPiece

      public void removeCustomPiece(String name)
      Removes a custom piece from the system. Prevents removal of standard pieces or non-custom entries.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the custom piece to remove

    • addNewCustomPiece

      public String addNewCustomPiece()
      Creates a new custom piece entry with a unique name. Automatically handles name generation (e.g., "Custom 1", "Custom 2") and assigns a unique ID for the new piece.
      Returns:
      the name of the newly created custom piece

    • getCustomPieceNames

      public List<String> getCustomPieceNames()
      Retrieves a sorted list of all custom piece names. Sorts numerically based on the suffix number in the name.

    • getAllPieceNames

      public List<String> getAllPieceNames()
      Retrieves a list of all piece names (standard and custom). Standard pieces (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L) are listed first, followed by custom pieces.
